'''Trogwhales''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of horned animals from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]]<ref name="GG12" /> in the [[Kintan system/Legends|Kintan system]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> of the [[Si'Klaata Cluster/Legends|Si'Klaata Cluster]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. The species evolved over several thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] due to [[Mutant|mutations]] caused by a large dose of [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] which originated from [[M'dweshuu]], a [[Star/Legends|star]] located at the heart of the Si'Klaata cluster, going [[Nova/Legends|nova]]. The species was immense in size and were considered fearsome monsters.<ref name="GG12" /> Due to the threat the trogwhales posed the sentient [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] species, who were also native to Kintan, the Nikto drove them to [[Death/Legends|extinction]].<ref name="GATOR">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'' states that the Nikto drove all life on Kintan to extinction except Flora and smaller non-threatening species. Due to their immense size and description as dangerous creatures this page assumes trogwhales were amongst those driven to extinction.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Trogwhales were first mentioned in [[1995]] in ''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'' a supplement book in the ''[[Galaxy Guide]]'' series for the roleplaying game by [[West End Games]], ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG12" />
